subject: Shell UID does not automatically bypass SSENSOR; physical registration is deletion gate
body: Against main 413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace: current DuoShellService has no direct SensorManager listener. AOSP SensorService permission enforcement checks required sensor permission against the actual caller; the special bypass is AID_SYSTEM, not adb shell UID 2000. Static getSensorList visibility does not establish that enable/register will succeed. Therefore the decisive Fold7 experiment is: verify Shizuku UserService UID/backend, check SSENSOR grant, enumerate full sensor metadata, then explicitly register type 36 plus private candidates (including 65686/65695/65697 and all hinge/fold/lid name matches) from app and shell contexts, recording return/exception, complete values[], event timestamp, callback monotonic time, cadence, reversal behavior, panel-swap continuity, and power-state behavior. Do not delete FoldInteractive until that physical proof exists.
